from: 4 broadcast screenshots of a grass-court final (front, side, ground views). The images stay on Ryan's Mac (not in git); these notes are what the game uses.

court.notes: mowing stripes run across the court (parallel to the baseline); the grass wears to sandy brown behind each baseline and around the service line

surround.notes: very tall, steep stands packed to the top; a roof edge over the top of the stands; officials in cream and green stand along the back wall

avoid: no tournament names, logos, crests or trademarked colour schemes (no purple)
